title: Apportioning the Price of a Vacation Package Across the Travelling Party
content:
A package among the Vacation Package Products is priced for the party as a whole and then apportioned traveller by traveller, so every per-person amount is read against the party actually travelling and never against the party first quoted.

## Per-traveller bases

A traveller occupying a room or cabin alone carries the product's single supplement, a third adult sharing takes its third-adult discount, and a child within the product's child age takes its child discount.

> The following clause of this rule is **no longer in force** and is not to be applied: "the supplement and the discounts never apply to the same traveller at once". It has been superseded by the current basis, and the position it stated no longer governs.

An infant under the product's infant age travels at the flat infant price and is not counted for occupancy, for discounts or for group ratios. The single supplement, the third-adult discount, the child age, the child discount, the infant age and the infant price are each the figure published against the product booked.

## Free places on a group booking

A group at or above the product's free-place ratio earns one free place for every full ratio of paying travellers, and the free place is always the lowest priced place in the party. Where a product publishes no free-place ratio, no free place arises on it at all.

## A party that shrinks after booking

Where the party shrinks after booking the remaining travellers are re-priced at the occupancy they are left with.

> The remainder of that clause is **no longer in force** and is not to be applied: "the re-pricing is charged as an amendment rather than absorbed". It has been superseded by the current basis. The re-pricing of the travellers who remain, stated in the sentence above, continues to govern.

## The loyalty concession within the desk's authority

A traveller who has booked more than the frequent-traveller threshold of packages in the last thirty-six months is offered the loyalty concession within the desk's authority and no other. That threshold stands at 3 packages, counted over the last thirty-six months, so a traveller with 4 such packages is above it and a traveller with exactly 3 is not.
